title: Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic
prompt:
Create an ultra-photorealistic cinematic lifestyle photograph of a young adult woman in her early twenties, approximately 20 years old, with an East Asian appearance, performing an everyday household chore in a quiet residential alley outside a modern urban home. Capture a candid, natural moment as she bends slightly forward to place a large translucent white plastic garbage bag into a gray outdoor trash bin. Use a vertical composition, framing her from the top of her head to her upper thighs and knees, with a natural eye-level perspective angled slightly downward.

She has a delicate oval-shaped face, softly rounded cheeks, a gently tapered chin, a petite straight nose, and naturally full, muted rosy-pink lips. Her fair skin has subtle peach undertones, realistic pores, and gentle daylight highlights. Her dark brown almond-shaped eyes gaze downward toward the garbage bag, framed by delicate eyelashes and softly defined eyebrows. Her expression is calm, focused, and thoughtful, with her head tilted downward and slightly toward her left shoulder.

Her rich dark chocolate-brown hair is gathered into a loosely twisted, slightly messy high bun, with airy wispy bangs falling naturally across her forehead and delicate loose strands framing her cheeks and neck.

She has a naturally curvaceous, feminine physique, with a slender waist, full prominent bust, softly rounded hips, and proportionate arms and legs. Her posture is slightly forward-leaning, with both arms extending downward toward the garbage bag. One hand holds the tied plastic handles while the other steadies the bag near the opening of the bin.

She wears a deep burgundy, wine-red halter-neck apron-style mini dress made from soft, slightly wrinkled cotton fabric. The garment features narrow halter straps extending from the bodice around her neck, a deeply plunging V-shaped neckline revealing substantial cleavage, a fitted front bodice, and an apron-like rectangular skirt extending to her upper thighs. The sides are dramatically open, exposing her bare waist and the outer side of her hip and thigh, with thin burgundy fabric ties fastened at the back and side. Preserve the garment's unusual open-sided construction, deep neckline, fabric folds, stitching, and natural drape exactly, without adding an undershirt, jacket, or additional visible clothing.

The environment includes a textured gray concrete-block wall, horizontal metal fencing, dense green shrubs, a neighboring residential entrance, gray pavement, and a large utilitarian garbage bin in the foreground. Soft afternoon sunlight provides balanced natural illumination, realistic skin tones, subtle shadows, and gentle highlights across her shoulders and arms.

Photograph with a 35mm full-frame lens, f/2.8 aperture, natural depth of field, authentic documentary-style smartphone realism, finely detailed skin and fabric textures, restrained cinematic contrast, warm-neutral color grading, and lifelike anatomical proportions. No artificial beauty filters, excessive retouching, stylization, or exaggerated body distortion. Vertical aspect ratio 9:16.
